description: A learner mid-task asks what to do next; the tutor answers about the work, and none of its own scripts, files, or state reach them.

profile.background: Five years of Python, mostly Django. Never worked on this codebase.
profile.why: Joining the billing team next week.

prompt: ok, what should I be doing right now?

graders.name: points at the work
graders.criteria: The tutor tells the learner, in plain terms, what the open exercise is: invoice totals come out too low when a line's quantity is more than one, in billing/invoice.py, and done means fixing that with a test. Judge that and only that; anything about the tutor's own machinery is for the other graders. Do not mark it down for saying it holds a reference solution the learner may ask for, for naming a `/rolling:` slash command, or for saying what the learner's own working copy already shows them, such as which branch they are on.
